{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVdzeZs8AAAABbtXjkQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bpi2wzhFQ4nc", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bpi2w", "number": 15, "title": "Align Animasa Miku Toon ramp and ambient/color-space shading with three-mmd-loader (keep light direction)", "body": "## Background

The published Animasa Miku in `three-motionbricks` appears noticeably glossier/brighter than the same pinned `miku_v2.pmd` rendered by `takahirox/three-mmd-loader`. Code inspection shows that both use MMD-specific Toon materials rather than core glTF PBR at runtime, but their Toon-ramp coordinate, ambient contribution, and color-space/composition rules differ.

The maintainer **approved improving Toon-ramp mapping and ambient/color-space behavior, but explicitly excluded changing the directional light direction**.

References:
- This repo: [`src/mmd.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/src/mmd.ts), [`src/main.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-motionbricks/blob/main/src/main.ts).
- The pinned `mmd-gltf` [Toon implementation](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/3dfa726aa38992a1f7d5ea17b377c685e839e8b8/packages/three-mmd-toon/shading.ts) and [plugin](https://github.com/takahirox/mmd-gltf/blob/3dfa726aa38992a1f7d5ea17b377c685e839e8b8/packages/three-mmd-toon/index.ts).
- Reference renderer: [`three-mmd-loader/src/materials/MMDToonMaterial.ts`](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/src/materials/MMDToonMaterial.ts), [material shading notes](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/docs/material-shading.md), and [demo lighting configuration](https://github.com/takahirox/three-mmd-loader/blob/main/examples/scene.ts).

## Requested changes

1. **Toon-ramp coordinate.** For the Animasa compatibility path, align the mapping with `three-mmd-loader`: change the current `clamp(dot(N,L) + 0.5, 0, 1)` to `clamp(dot(N,L) * 0.5 + 0.5, 0, 1)`. Check UV orientation and actual embedded ramp sampling so the intended ramp is selected (not simply a numerically similar, inverted sample).
2. **Ambient + color-space handling.** Compare and align with `three-mmd-loader`'s relevant material composition: authored ambient factor of **0.5**, sRGB source-factor decoding / linear working-space calculations, texture/Toon sampling boundaries, and the order of diffuse, ambient, Toon, and final output conversion. Preserve source PMD material factors rather than baking modified values into the GLB. Avoid double sRGB decoding/encoding and excess brightness/clipping.
3. **Compatibility isolation.** The `mmd-gltf` custom extension has an existing documented shading contract used by other consumers. Implement these as an **explicit opt-in renderer compatibility mode/configuration** (or equivalent isolated solution) rather than silently changing all `MMD_materials_toon` assets. Enable that behavior for **Animasa Miku in this repo**, with existing Uka and default `mmd-gltf` behavior retained unless individually justified. Update the pinned dependency/revision only after any necessary upstream implementation and tests.
4. **Keep authored specular.** Do **not** zero or arbitrarily attenuate PMD specular RGB/shininess, or modify the source assets. Verify how highlights change after the Toon/Ambient corrections.

### Explicitly out of scope

- **Do not change the directional light direction** or the existing `createToonLighting()` direction in this task. Do not attempt to solve this by changing scene light position/intensity or turning off specular.
- Do not reconvert/replace the pinned public Animasa GLB, modify the exact source textures/notices or their SHA-256, or alter retargeting, MotionBricks inference, outlines, IK, physics, or the deployment asset allowlist.
- Matching `three-mmd-loader`'s appearance is the reference goal; do not claim pixel-perfect fidelity with the original MikuMikuDance executable without primary captures.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The Animasa compatibility path uses the `0.5 * dot(N,L) + 0.5` Toon coordinate, with tests covering representative normal/light dot products and ramp orientation/texture sampling.
- [ ] Ambient uses the intended `0.5` coefficient, and documented color-space/contribution tests cover diffuse + ambient + Toon + specular without accidental extra brightness or double conversion.
- [ ] Same source model, rest pose/camera, and controlled light inputs are compared against the `three-mmd-loader` rendering; capture before/after images and record concrete visual/numeric differences. State which differences remain.
- [ ] Runtime verifies that Animasa meshes use the MMD Toon material/plugin, not the core glTF PBR fallback; source specular values remain intact.
- [ ] No directional-light direction change; unrelated Uka/default `mmd-gltf` appearance is not accidentally changed.
- [ ] Existing `npm test`, build, Pages-artifact checks, and available browser rendering/character-switching regressions pass. Record results and screenshots in the PR.
